answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 46622 Country: India Title: regarding to pursue mba with regard to beard Question: I am a student and I want to do MBA from marketing and I have beard. My question is can I do MBA from finance stream. Is doing MBA from finance haram or halal? Please guide me. Answer ID: 46622 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1259/933/B=10/1434) Yes, you may do MBA in finance. It is allowed as per Shariah. You may do it while keeping beard as well. It shall be good. Do not worry. Do MBA in marketing and regularly offer salah and observe fast. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
